item.title: Why the Medium Popcorn Exists (And It Is Not For You)
item.description: Walk up to a movie counter with two popcorn sizes, and most people calmly pick the small. Three dollars feels reasonable. Seven dollars feels excessive. Behavioral economists call this the Decoy Effect.
